purpose: Improve short-message and scope transfer while preserving long-input behavior
initial_candidate: review-04 development-selected checkpoint, once training completes
weighting: Equal total training-loss weight for each language x short-single-turn/other x binary-target group. Short means one turn of at most 12 whitespace-delimited words.
partition_protection: Remove normalized input overlap against both current training and every recorded prior-training input; preserve transitive history for later continuations
selection: Same fixed >=99 percent review recall target in each language and formal/conversational development group; minimize worst-group false review; calibration after fitting
short_training_source: Development error classes, not independent validation
